Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.
The focus_unit_id identifies the clause to classify. Other supplied units are context for resolving its references, not additional effects to merge into that focus. Interpret the acquired operation for that focus clause, using its actual context.

Do not infer retention from silence, classify an ordinary ongoing no-copy rule as post-disposal retention, or confuse survival of confidentiality with retention."}], "current_queries": [{"id": "retention:31", "operation": "retention_clause", "unit_ids": [28, 29, 30, 31], "current_units": [{"id": 28, "text": "E. “Representative” means directors, officers, employees, accountants, attorneys, lenders of funds and agents of a party or its affiliates."}, {"id": 29, "text": "II. NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT: Both parties recognizes and acknowledges that, in an effort to foster the Discussions one or both of the parties has provided and/or will provide, at no cost, fee, charge or expense to Receiving Party, Confidential Information of a special and unique value and nature developed and/or acquired by (and/or being developed or acquired by) Originating Party at great expense and cost to Originating Party which, if it were to come into the possession of Originating Party’s competitors, would cause irreparable damage to Originating Party, its competitive advantage and its ability to operate profitably."}, {"id": 30, "text": "Receiving Party acknowledges that, prior to its relationship with Originating Party and prior to execution of this Agreement, Receiving Party had no knowledge of any of the aforesaid information."}, {"id": 31, "text": "Receiving Party therefore agrees that neither it nor its Representatives will at any time make any independent business or personal use of, retain, copy, divulge, disclose, reveal or communicate to any other person or organization (except as expressly authorized in writing by Originating Party, as required to analyze the Business Relationship or as required to fulfill Receiving Party’s obligations to Originating Party) any Confidential Information."}], "focus_unit_id": 31}]}
